# Weave

> Stories, podcasts, and culture for everyone.

Weave is a digital platform and media network built for everyone. It unites authentic writing, cultural photography, community discussions, connected apps, and podcasts into an integrated experience.

## Key Sections

- [Home](https://weave.akiba-hara.workers.dev/): Media hero, trending topics, community voice polls, latest blogs, and culture snapshots.
- [Blogs](https://weave.akiba-hara.workers.dev/blogs): Community-written stories, opinions, lifestyle guides, and perspectives.
- [Submit a Blog](https://weave.akiba-hara.workers.dev/submit): Public submission portal for readers to submit stories and thought pieces for editorial review.
- [Podcasts](https://weave.akiba-hara.workers.dev/podcasts): Audio and video conversations covering faith, careers, relationships, technology, and everyday life.
- [Culture](https://weave.akiba-hara.workers.dev/culture): Visual gallery capturing moments, events, and everyday life across our community.
- [Explore](https://weave.akiba-hara.workers.dev/explore): The wider ecosystem of platforms including WAVE (community networking), PLAWZA (marketplace and housing), and STITCH (careers and opportunities).
- [About](https://weave.akiba-hara.workers.dev/about): Mission, background, and vision behind Weave.
- [Contact](https://weave.akiba-hara.workers.dev/contact): Direct communication, feedback, and community channels.

## Legal & Policies

- [Privacy Policy](https://weave.akiba-hara.workers.dev/privacy): Data collection, usage, and privacy commitments.
- [Terms of Service](https://weave.akiba-hara.workers.dev/terms): Platform guidelines and user agreements.
- [Cookie Policy](https://weave.akiba-hara.workers.dev/cookies): Information about cookies and local storage.
